blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — Philippine National Police (PNP) chief Gen. Jose Melencio Nartatez Jr. stressed that police must remain impartial and uphold due process in all operations after Vice President Sara Duterte described the agency as an “enforcement arm” of politicians. “Impartiality is a principle that we strive to uphold in every police operation and public service,” Nartatez said in a statement on Sunday. “Our commitment is to treat everyone with fairness, respect, and compassion, while providing equal protection under the law regardless of one’s position or political affiliation,” he added.
